actions.idle: One page of the open book lifts slowly, turns from right to left and settles flat. The book cover and spine stay completely still. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; no new objects.
The small blue magic orb gently pulses and its tiny star glints twinkle. Its golden stand stays completely still. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; no new objects.

The quill gently writes a short stroke in the open work ledger then returns to its resting position. The ledger stays still. Subtle seamless idle loop; no letters or text; fixed camera; no new objects.
Thin curls of steam gently rise from the teacup and fade, repeating. The cup, tea and saucer stay completely still. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; no new objects.
The compass needle gently swings a little left and right and returns north. The round case stays completely still. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; no new objects.
The small blue tournament flag gently ripples in a light breeze. The pole and golden base stay completely still. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; preserve the emblem; no new objects.
The small candle flame gently flickers left and right. The wax candle and brass holder stay completely still. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; no new objects.
The three small leaves gently flutter in place in a soft breeze and return to their initial positions. Small motion only. Subtle seamless idle loop; fixed camera; no new objects.
